title: Rescaled carrier and multiplicity form a rectifiable varifold
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} be any set, and let V = v(M, θ) be a rectifiable n-varifold in U in the sense of the frozen contract (structure RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U): M ⊆ U is H^n-null-measurable and countably n-rectifiable (M ⊆ M₀ ∪ ⋃_j range F_j with H^n(M₀) = 0 and each F_j : ℝ^n → ℝ^{n+ℓ} Lipschitz), and θ : ℝ^{n+ℓ} → ℝ is positive on M, almost-everywhere measurable for H^n⌞M, and H^n-integrable on M ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U, where H^n = μHE[n]. Let c ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}, R > 0 and ψ(x) := c + R x. Then there is a rectifiable n-varifold W in ψ⁻¹(U) whose carrier is ψ⁻¹(M) and whose multiplicity satisfies W.mult(x) = θ(c + R x) for every x ∈ ℝ^{n+ℓ}.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (c : Amb n ℓ) (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∃ W : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' U), W.carrier = (fun x => c + R • x) ⁻¹' V.carrier ∧ ∀ x, W.mult x = V.mult (c + R • x)
